page.layout: One printed page, one text column; heading centred above it; fragments of marginal notes at the left edge of the scan (cut off, partly visible, from the facing page) are not transcribed as notes.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.
main_text.p: omnes suas virtutes complexus est. Itaque ad exemplum ejus te componis, Animum regis; hoc tibi gentilitium est; & Ratione regis eum: novisti enim cupiditatum & affectuum lupatis aut calcaribus, non regi animum, sed frangi vel efferari: Proinde jam alterum symbolum accipe, quem Romanus Sapiens (id dicere volui, Vates) tibi inculcat, Multos reges. nam sic inquit, Multos reges, si Ratio te rexerit. Hisce tuis, & illustrium parentum suorum

page.notes: The left margin shows only cropped fragments of text from the facing page (e.g. "nam", "bus", "cir-", "nor-"), which are not transcribed. The last word "rum" stands alone at the right of the final line. The "s" in "si" is a long s rendered as printed; the "f" in "efferari" and "si" appear as printed in the scan. Text is set in roman with italic passages as shown.
